description: Old Searchlight (fork c7363de) question types per old game sentinel and family, mapped to the current preloaded game's question ID (null: no equivalent, see reason). Old type = payload data.type, or data.locationType for tentacles. zone/letter-zone entries apply to the payload's cat.adminLevel given in adminLevel or byAdminLevel. Generated from the per-game restore notes; see scripts/legacy-import/report-question-map.ts.
